user.title: Hive Local TRV
user.description: Enter your Zigbee2MQTT base topic. TRVs are discovered automatically.

data_description.z2m_base_topic: Must match base_topic in your Zigbee2MQTT configuration (default: zigbee2mqtt)

abort.already_configured: This Zigbee2MQTT instance is already configured.

init.title: Hive Local TRV
init.description: What would you like to configure?

settings.title: Device Settings
settings.description: Configure your boiler entity, geofencing, and diagnostic logging.

data_description.boiler_entity: Turned on or off based on TRV heat demand. Supports climate, switch, and input_boolean.
data_description.person_entities: When all selected people leave home, frost protection activates automatically.
data_description.enable_diagnostics: Writes HIVE_DIAG entries to the HA log. Useful for troubleshooting — disable once working.

rooms.title: Room Groups
rooms.description: Add or remove virtual room groups that control multiple TRVs together.

add_room.title: Add Room Group — Step 1 of 2
add_room.description: Enter a name for the room and the Zigbee2MQTT friendly names of all TRVs in it.

data_description.room_name: Display name for the room group, e.g. Living Room.
data_description.trv_names: Zigbee2MQTT friendly names as shown in Z2M Devices, separated by commas. Example: Living Room TRV, Living Room TRV 2

add_room_sensors.title: Add Room Group — Step 2 of 2
add_room_sensors.description: Optionally add extra temperature sensors to include in the room average. Room: {room_name} ({trv_count} TRV(s))

data_description.temp_sensors: HA temperature sensor entities to include alongside the TRV readings when calculating the room average.

remove_room.title: Remove Room Group
remove_room.description: Select the room group to remove. Individual TRV entities are not affected.
